items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: The interviewee corrects the interviewer regarding his own name: 'Joseph. Joseph, huh? Edward Joseph, Eddie Joseph.'

ctx.x: This is Rio 3, Eddie Dawson, January the 31st, 1962. You want to sit here and watch the machine Barry? That'll make it easier for me. Sure. And the donut's going to come. We've got minus one mark on top, you see. Okay. Let's see. Can we get your name on here again? Yeah. Your full name, I never did get that. Eddie Dawson. That's your full name? Yeah. No middle name? No.
Joseph. Joseph, huh? Edward Joseph, Eddie Joseph.
And you mentioned some guys gave you a nickname, huh?
